components.name: Studio rail item
components.description: Expanded Studio rail destination: 44px minimum row, 21px icon, neutral current-page surface. Rail is 232px expanded or 76px collapsed; collapsed rows are at least 48px. Preference persists locally; below 768px use a compact menu.
components.html: Overview

components.name: Project resource tabs
components.description: One scrollable line-style strip per selected-project workspace; canvas is a separate destination. Editors appear after selection or creation. Transfer controls belong in Project actions.
components.html: CharactersScenesAssets
components.css: .ds-resource-tabs{display:flex;gap:15px;overflow:auto;padding:16px 0 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-family:var(--font-sans,sans-serif)}.ds-resource-tabs a{flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;padding:9px 10px;color:var(--muted-foreground);text-decoration:none;position:relative;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px}.ds-resource-tabs a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--accent-foreground)}.ds-resource-tabs a[aria-current=page]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-5px;height:2px;background:var(--foreground)}.ds-resource-tabs a:hover{color:var(--foreground)}.ds-resource-tabs a:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ring);border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent)}

components.name: Viewing rail item
components.description: Viewing navigation above 650px: 232px expanded or 76px collapsed, 44px expanded rows and 48px collapsed rows. Independent videoflow.viewer.sidebar preference persists; absent a preference, widths at or below 1000px initially collapse. At 650px and below use Discover, Shorts, Following and You bottom navigation. Collapsed links retain accessible labels and titles.
components.html: Discover

components.name: Template concept cover
components.description: 16:9 image-led Explainer, Product story and Short story covers labelled AI concept artwork. Optimized 960px WebP assets and exact prompts are recorded in frontend/static/artwork/provenance.json. These are editable starter concepts, never published videos or generation results. Empty Discover links select the matching /templates?starter= ID. Template creation preserves script, scene and shot import without spending generation credits. At 1000px and below, the template chooser uses a locally scrolling three-card row with 260px minimum card widths and proximity snapping; the structure/form review stacks. Mount and container resize center the selected card within the local row without scrolling the page. Empty Discover starter links instead stack at 650px. At 600px and below the empty introduction uses 20px vertical padding and hides its film icon; the guest action is Explore templates.

components.name: Viewing search
components.description: Desktop header search is a labelled 42px form, maximum width 620px. Submit a trimmed encoded query to /search?q=…. The search route retains its own form and hides the header form. At 650px and below the header uses a search link.
components.html: <form class="ds-view-search" role="search"><input type="search" aria-label="Search videos" placeholder="Search videos"><button type="submit" aria-label="Search">Search</button></form>
components.css: .ds-view-search{display:flex;max-width:620px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden}.ds-view-search input{min-width:0;width:100%;padding:0 18px;background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font-sans,sans-serif);font-size:14px;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-view-search button{width:60px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--muted);color:var(--foreground);border-left:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-view-search button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: 6eek’s existing workspace, aligned with its landing-page brand
narrative.overview:
6eek uses warm ink surfaces, bone text and a restrained signal-orange accent within its existing shadcn interface. The supplied logo connects watching, account management and Studio without changing their task-specific layouts.

Inter, compact controls, fine borders and muted supporting copy remain the incumbent visual language. Media and the original Studio canvas lead; brand appears in the logo, primary actions and selected states.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ink and bone surfaces with signal-orange actions.
Compact shadcn controls and readable Inter typography.
Original Studio canvas with a quiet overview and focused project resource workspace.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use ink text on signal-orange fills and the theme-specific active/muted tokens for text. Measured pairs: signal/ink 6.32:1, bone/ink 16.13:1, mute/ink-2 7.20:1, light-muted/bone 5.26:1 and light-active/bone 5.55:1. These pairs do not certify every opacity, state or overlay.

dos: Do use semantic CSS tokens from frontend/src/app.css in both themes.
Do use the supplied theme-appropriate logo through BrandLogo.svelte.
Do preserve CJK font fallbacks, visible keyboard focus and distinct error states.
Do preserve media proportions and Studio canvas behavior while using one resource tab strip per project workspace.
Do keep overview continuation prominent, editors conditional on selection or creation, and project transfer actions inside Project actions.
Do label starter covers as AI concept artwork and link empty Discover suggestions to the matching starter parameter; preserve actual published-video thumbnails.
donts: Don't redraw, recolor or stretch the supplied logo.
Don't replace Inter or the existing shadcn compositions as part of brand alignment.
Don't use bright orange for small light-mode text when the contrast-safe active token is available.
Don't turn status colors into brand orange or invent production media and earnings claims.
